title: MrRoPE: Mixed-radix Rotary Position Embedding

layout.note: A wide left-to-right chain: a titled stack of three tinted strips, three converging block arrows into the MrRoPE Theory box with its formula hanging below, a thick Special Cases arrow, and a titled stepped bar chart with a legend row on top.

lesson: To unify several prior methods, stack one tinted strip per method with the same mini plot, funnel them with labelled block arrows into a single theory box that carries the master formula, then show the special cases as variants of one schematic chart.
